meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: Claude 会帮你制作一个可交互的幻灯片演示文稿，包含独立的幻灯片、逐步显示的内容片段、可点击的热点导航、分支流程以及演讲者备注。输出的是一个可直接运行的网页版幻灯片，而不是视频。
howto.when: 当你明确要求制作幻灯片、演示文稿、交互式演示，或要求将现有页面转换为幻灯片时触发。如果请求不明确，Claude 会先确认你的意图。

say.text: 帮我做一个关于我们产品的幻灯片演示。
say.note: Claude 会开始制作幻灯片，并可能先确认你的需求。

say.text: 把这个网页转换成幻灯片。
say.note: Claude 会分析页面内容并生成对应的幻灯片。

say.text: 在第三张幻灯片上添加一个热点，链接到分支序列。
say.note: Claude 会在指定幻灯片上创建可点击的热点。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you create an interactive slideshow presentation with discrete slides, fragment reveals, clickable hotspots for branching, and presenter notes. The output is a navigable web-based deck, not a video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, presentation, pitch deck, interactive deck, or request to convert an existing page into a deck. If unclear, Claude confirms before proceeding.

say_en.text: Create a slideshow about our product.
Convert this webpage into a slideshow.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the page and generate corresponding slides.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on slide 3 linking to a branch sequence.
say_en.note: Claude will create a clickable hotspot on the specified slide.
